bestBets.overview: SALANN looks a really nice filly. Stakes placed over 1200m on debut then was stepped up 400m sent the opposite direction in Sydney and was enormous rushing home in the 1600m Fernhill Stakes when other placegetters sat on pace. Lovely Flemington jumpout. ZAMBALES sat a lot closer when resuming in Sandown maiden and stuck on well on Soft 7. Race is hot form even so far with third placed Boys Bounce winning easily in town and Somethings Burnin' a good thing beaten on the same card. MENESS looked sharp in recent Cranbourne jumpout win over the smart Rubi's Choice. Outstanding second at Sandown when slipped at the start and midraced clipped heels and was halfway down on the ground and somehow stood up, but still rallied to place. SANTA BARBARA gets into the field and drops in class from the Quezette Group3 after bold run in Saturday company on debut. FRINGILLA gave tearaway leader a big touch up when let loose late in Flemington jump out, zooming clear last 100m. TRUE REBEL sat wide on the speed when holding off Group race performer Salann in Flemington jump out. WRITTEN EMPIRE moved clear of rivals in Flemington jump out on soft5 and was geared down, then stalked leader when 2nd in most recent Flemington jump out.

raceTips.comment:
An excellent maiden that wouldn't be out of place on a metropolitan program and probably a stronger race than the first at Sandown on Saturday. 
Zambales had strong two-year-old form hence starting odds-on first up at Sandown. He was beaten by a smart winner, should strip much fitter for the run and gets blinkers back on. He can potentially roll forward and the horse he was beaten by last start might be above average. 
Santa Barbara was excellent on debut at Flemington when narrowly defeated before getting too far back in a strong Quezette Stakes last start. She can improve sharply here dropping in class and rising in distance. 
Meness has jumped out nicely ahead of his return having shown ability before a spell. Mark Zahra takes the ride and no surprise to see him resume with a win. 
Salann ran well in both starts at Stakes level as a two-year-old and has jumped out well. She could easily be top pick highlighting the depth of this race!

raceTips.comment:
Monsieur Claude makes his debut as a four-year-old entire following three jumpouts. He won the first and could've won the second when strong late under light riding on the Pakenham synthetic track. It was his latest against a strong field on the Caulfield Heath track where he hit the line impressively under little riding that particularly caught the eye. If he can bring that form to the races he looks well placed to win on debut. 
Boss Bundle hit the line strongly first up, strips fitter, Blake Shinn sticks and he can potentially settle closer. 
Mr Spendedoe ran well on debut and looks the potential leader.
Sumaluv was arguably unlucky not to win last start and maybe peaks third up. 
I don't think Brilliant Bull Ant handles heavy ground. His soft track form earlier in the preparation puts him right in contention for this, however he has a bad habit of missing the start.
